Container.Name: duels-review-claude
Container.Overview: Claude Code with the Discord plugin, reviewing duels.ink Lorcana replay links posted in Discord. Uses your Claude subscription login. First-time setup: open the container's Console and run: tmux attach -t claude

Config.Name: Claude home (login, plugin, Discord token)
Config.Description: Keeps the Claude Code install, your Claude login, the Discord plugin and its pairing settings.

Config.Name: Work folder (reviews, matchup notes)
Config.Description: Saved reviews, transcripts, timings and your context.md matchup notes.

Config.Name: Claude flags
Config.Description: Leave as is so the bot runs unattended. Clear it to get Allow/Deny permission buttons in your Discord DMs instead.

Config.Name: Discord webhook URL (usage-limit alerts)
Config.Description: Optional. A webhook for your replay channel (Server Settings, Integrations, Webhooks). When your Claude usage limit is hit, a message with the reset time is posted there.
